From our humble 30 years ago, Wildlife SOS has grown to be one of the premier wildlife rescue organizations in the world. 
At Wildlife SOS, we focus on protecting India’s wild animals in their natural habitats as well as on rescuing and caring for orphaned, injured and exploited wildlife. We operate two rescue centers for elephants, five for bears, one for leopards, and one for birds and primates. 

Our videos give you behind the scenes look at our rescue operations, our animals, and our programs. Subscribe today to be notified when we post something new!
